data.answer: A riveter is a person who installs industrial-strength metal fasteners on airplanes or ships, using a handheld tool also called a riveter. In the context of social sciences and humanities, riveters utilize a range of hand and power tools to align, assemble, and fasten components using rivets. The term "riveter" also refers to an AI-driven system that finds and structures data from the web using AI agents, which searches, navigates, and extracts exactly what is needed.
